name: dwarfs-glob-bitparallel-blueprint1
instr:
`src/glob_matcher.cpp` matches case-sensitive pathname globs through a fast bit-parallel path, but only for short patterns — longer ones fall back to `std::regex`. Extend the fast path so it also handles patterns of up to 128 tokens built from literals, `?`, and embedded `*`, keeping `glob_matcher`'s public API and matching behavior unchanged. Other glob forms can stay on the regex path.

The extended path must preserve exact matching behavior, pattern options, and multiple-pattern semantics. A warmed match on a newly eligible pattern must not allocate, and matching these long patterns must be at least twice as fast as the current regex fallback. Validate against the native matcher tests.
